name: Lalit Kumar Behera
tagline: Mobile architect with 11+ years of experience — designing reliable, scalable app ecosystems across native Android, Flutter, React Native, and Kotlin backends.
about: I'm a mobile engineer and architect with over a decade of experience shipping apps across e-commerce, healthcare, and enterprise — including products serving more than a million users.

My work sits at the intersection of architecture and reliability: setting technical direction, making build-vs-buy and platform decisions, and engineering stability at scale — from a 99.6% crash-free rate to cutting ANRs by 99%. I work across native Android (Kotlin, Jetpack Compose), Flutter, React Native, and Kotlin backend services, and I multiply my impact by mentoring engineers and raising the bar on code review and testing culture. Based in Bengaluru, India.
